summary: v56s batch tested end-to-end (backend pytest 12/12 + Playwright UI). Go-Live switch (public/admin GET, admin PUT, auth/role enforcement, persistence), Go-Live enforcement on notice create (422) and registration submit (400) when ON and permissive when OFF, public notice filters (sector_code/contract_type_code/category), vendor category-request taxonomy persistence all PASS. UI: Masters->Go-live toggle ON/OFF with toasts + meta + persistence after reload PASS; tender board filters/deep-link/refresh/clear PASS; vendor categories cascade + taxonomy in POST body PASS; #6 REQUIRED pill renders (red bg, white bold) PASS; #15 registrations selection resets on status tab switch PASS. FOUND+FIXED 1 bug: Registration Section D sector/contract choice was silently dropped on Save draft (a second hard-coded whitelist in RegistrationResume.jsx lacked the 4 new fields) - fixed and re-verified (power/epc persists after reload). FOUND 1 HIGH data/logic bug (not fixed): the Sector->Contract-type cascade can never surface child contract types because contract_types.parent_code points to contract-type GROUP codes (ppp/epc/supply/works/services), not to sector codes. Go-live flag left = FALSE at the end.

minor.issue: Go-live check runs AFTER next_sequence('notice_seq'), so every rejected (422) create burns a notice_ref number (gaps in PMC-NOT-YYYY-#### sequence). Move the is_go_live() check above next_sequence.

sector_code / contract_type_code are not validated against the sectors/contract_types masters nor cross-checked (any string accepted, e.g. 'TEST_x'). With go-live ON a garbage code satisfies the gate.

limit clamped to 100 server-side but TendersList requests limit=200 and filters client-side; once >100 published notices exist, filters silently miss older notices. Should pass sector_code/contract_type_code/category/country to the API or paginate. (Currently 58 published, so not yet visible.)
Go-live gate only on create; editing/publishing an existing draft without taxonomy is allowed while ON (may be intended - 'new notices only' - confirm).

ui_bugs.component: Sector -> Contract type cascade (TendersList, SectionD, VendorCategories, all 3 places)
ui_bugs.issue: Filter `!c.parent_code || c.parent_code === sector` never matches because contract_types parent_code values are 'ppp','epc','supply','works','services' (contract-type groups), not sector codes. Result: for EVERY sector only the 7 top-level groups (epc, framework, om, ppp, services, supply, works) show; the 23 child contract types (ppp-bot, ppp-boot, ppp-annuity, services-advisory, ...) are unreachable. The cascade is effectively not sector-dependent.

FIXED by testing agent: local whitelist dropped sector_code/sector_name/contract_type_code/contract_type_name so Section D taxonomy never saved (toast said 'Saved'). Added the 4 fields; verified persistence.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls settingsApi goLive (/settings/go-live/public is defined in api.js but unused). Sector/Contract fields don't show REQUIRED pill when go-live is ON and there is no client-side pre-check; user only learns at final submit via a 400.

issues: Column header 'SECTOR · COUNTRY' actually shows notice.category (e.g. 'Civil Works', 'general'), not sector_name
Hero title says 'Live tenders' while 'All' mode is selected
Sector dropdown lists sub-sectors flat (power-transmission etc.) with no grouping; a notice tagged power-transmission will not match 'Power & Energy'
Legacy free-text 'Primary sector' sits right above the new 'Sector' select - redundant/confusing
REQUIRED pill is 9px - legible but small
Sector/Contract selects have no visible labels (only placeholder option)
Pending request cards don't display the chosen sector/contract type
Status tabs show raw snake_case (UNDER_REVIEW, NEEDS_CLARIFICATION)
After toggle, go-live-meta updates updated_at locally but keeps old updated_by (stale if a different admin last changed it)

action_items: HIGH: Fix the Sector->Contract-type cascade - either re-parent contract_types to sector codes (or add a sector_codes[] mapping), or change the UI to show all contract types grouped by parent group (optgroup) instead of filtering by parent_code === sector. Apply in TendersList.jsx (2 places), SectionD.jsx, VendorCategories.jsx.
Move is_go_live() check above next_sequence() in routers/notices.py create_notice to avoid burning notice refs.
Validate sector_code/contract_type_code against masters on notice create/update, registration PATCH/submit and category request.
Use /settings/go-live/public in SectionD to mark Sector/Contract REQUIRED when go-live is ON.
TendersList: send filters to backend or paginate (backend caps limit at 100).
Fix 'SECTOR · COUNTRY' column to show sector_name (fallback category).

Contract-type cascade filter logic duplicated in 4 places - extract a helper.

rca of the issue: Section D save bug: RegistrationResume.saveDraft applies its own hard-coded whitelist before calling registrationApi.update; v56s added the 4 taxonomy fields only to lib/api.js REGISTRATION_UPDATE_FIELDS, so saveDraft deleted them first (console warn '[saveDraft] dropping unknown fields'). Repro: pick Sector/Contract in D -> Save draft -> reload -> both empty; DB sector_code None. Fix: add fields to the local whitelist (done). Cascade bug: contract_types seed uses parent_code for intra-contract-type hierarchy (group->child), while the UI assumes parent_code = sector code.
